skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-chatgpt-ads-conversions-api
skill.description: Connect a Cloudflare storefront to ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics and the OpenAI Conversions API. Configure consent and verify delivery with a test purchase.
skill.summary: Set up and verify server-side ChatGPT Ads purchase tracking for a Cloudflare storefront.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance matches and most backtick matches are documentation, not system probing or shell substitution. The review confirmed real CLI, remote service, and package installation risks, plus gaps in credential handling, browser handoffs, Cloudflare permission review, and data-sharing approval. No evidence of malicious intent or prompt injection was found in the four reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The agent credential exception conflicts with the no-chat guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the exception for API keys. Require the merchant to enter the key in the verified Product Metrics interface, outside chat and command arguments.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare troubleshooting instructs users to approve every permission.
remediation.suggestion: Document each required permission and its purpose. Ask a workspace admin to review the target account, zone, and sitewide changes before approval.

remediation.issue: Destination setup enables forwarding before the workflow verifies consent settings.
remediation.suggestion: Keep event sending off until the merchant approves the destination and payload. Test that declining marketing consent prevents delivery before enabling production traffic.

remediation.issue: Browser sign-in handoffs lack destination verification.
remediation.suggestion: Verify HTTPS and the expected provider host before presenting a sign-in or authorization link. Stop if the URL or redirect does not match.

remediation.issue: The install example uses an unpinned package runner and skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and skill revision. Provide manual installation from a reviewed revision and require confirmation before running any installer.

remediation.issue: Authenticated tools can read order data and change tracking settings.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the company, property, and planned writes with the merchant. Use narrowly scoped credentials and prefer test-order or status-only output.

remediation.issue: Live reference pages can replace the reviewed local instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle versioned references with the skill. Treat any live documentation as untrusted guidance and do not use it to authorize tool actions.

semantic_findings.title: Agent Workflow Permits API Key Collection
semantic_findings.description: The secret rule allows asking for an OpenAI Conversions API key and passing it to a command. The connection guide says never to paste it into chat.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception and no-chat warning are explicit. Asking the merchant for the key could expose it to the conversation or tool records.

semantic_findings.title: Cloudflare Permission Approval Lacks Scope Review
semantic_findings.description: The guide tells administrators to approve every permission after an authorization failure. The gateway adds tracking to every page of the selected domain.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The sitewide change and blanket approval instruction are documented. The files do not explain individual permissions or require a review of their scope.

semantic_findings.title: Forwarding Enabled Before Consent Verification
semantic_findings.description: The guide saves the destination with sending enabled before checking the consent banner. Eligible events can include hashed contact details, IP address, and browser metadata.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow enables sending before verifying consent settings and tests only the accepted path. The documents claim consent gating, so unauthorized delivery is not established.

semantic_findings.title: Browser Handoff Does Not Verify the Destination
semantic_findings.description: The workflow asks the merchant to open a URL returned by a tool without verifying its destination. Browser setup can involve sign-in and Cloudflare authorization.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The handoff rule does not require checking the provider or redirect. No malicious URL or compromised tool response was observed.

content.user_title: Set Up ChatGPT Ads Tracking on Cloudflare
content.value_statement: Browser pixels can miss purchase events. Connect your Cloudflare storefront through Product Metrics and verify that eligible purchases reach ChatGPT Ads.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status to identify completed steps and missing connections.
Guide a workspace admin through connecting the Cloudflare zone and linking the storefront to a Product Metrics property.
Guide the merchant through adding the ChatGPT Ads pixel as an OpenAI Conversions API destination.
Identify which consent banner setting to check before testing delivery.
Use a test purchase to distinguish storefront capture from delivery to ChatGPT Ads.
Explain when revenue, profit, and lifetime value events are available.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, access to Ads Manager, and a Cloudflare storefront with a proxied DNS record.
A workspace admin must authorize the Cloudflare gateway. Campaign optimization choices remain manual.
Only eligible new events are sent with marketing consent. Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds do not revise sent events.
Website orders lack product costs, so profit estimates need a fallback cost percentage and additional costs.

use_cases.title: Connect a Storefront Without a Plugin
use_cases.description: Use Cloudflare Tracking to connect your storefront, then verify that Product Metrics receives a paid test order.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Missing Purchase Conversions
use_cases.description: Check whether Product Metrics captured the purchase, whether consent permits forwarding, and whether ChatGPT Ads accepted the event.

use_cases.title: Review Tracking Before Launch
use_cases.description: Review the selected zone, consent banner, and browser pixel setup before enabling production conversion delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: What access and accounts do I need to track purchases from my Cloudflare storefront in ChatGPT Ads? Do not make any changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: You are preparing for the initial setup.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Existing Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the setup status for [property]. Tell me what is connected and which steps I need to complete in the browser.
prompt_templates.scenario: You already have a Product Metrics property.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Missing Conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me trace a test purchase for [property]. Check storefront capture, consent, and OpenAI delivery without showing customer details or changing settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: A test purchase does not appear in Ads Manager.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Verification
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the rollout plan for [property]. Include approved and declined marketing consent, browser pixel deduplication, and the prerequisites for profit events.
prompt_templates.scenario: You are validating the integration before production use.

output_examples.input: The Cloudflare gateway is complete, but ChatGPT Ads is not connected. What comes next?
output: Keep the existing gateway. Check that the storefront is linked to the intended Product Metrics property.
Create a Conversions API key for the intended pixel. Enter it directly in the Product Metrics interface, not in chat.
Verify the site's consent banner and approved data sharing before enabling production delivery.

output_examples.input: Product Metrics shows my test purchase, but it is missing in Ads Manager.
output: The storefront captured the purchase. Check marketing consent and the delivery result in the OpenAI Conversions API panel.
A validation event from saving the destination does not appear in Ads Manager. Verify delivery with a separate eligible purchase.

best_practices: Confirm the Cloudflare zone, Product Metrics property, and Ads Manager pixel before approving any changes.
Enter the Conversions API key directly in the verified Product Metrics interface.
Test with both accepted and declined marketing consent. Check storefront capture and Ads Manager delivery separately.
anti_patterns: Pasting a Conversions API key into a chat or support transcript.
Approving Cloudflare permissions or enabling event forwarding before reviewing the access and data involved.
Treating a saved destination or an accepted validation event as proof that a purchase appears in Ads Manager.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin?
faq.answer: No. An authorized admin connects the proxied storefront through the Product Metrics Cloudflare gateway.

faq.question: Who completes the sign-in and pixel setup?
faq.answer: A workspace admin approves Cloudflare access. A person with access to Ads Manager creates the pixel key and enters it in Product Metrics.

faq.question: What happens when a shopper declines marketing consent?
faq.answer: Product Metrics documents that it does not send the event to ChatGPT Ads without marketing consent. Verify this behavior with your configured banner.

faq.question: Can I keep the browser pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. Deduplication requires the same pixel ID, event name, and event ID. Cart and checkout events may need a developer to pass matching IDs.

faq.question: Why are profit events missing?
faq.answer: Profit events require a complete contribution margin. Cloudflare website orders need a fallback product cost percentage and any applicable additional costs.

faq.question: Are older orders or later refunds sent to ChatGPT Ads?
faq.answer: Historical orders are not imported. The guide documents a seven-day event limit, and later refunds do not revise events already sent.
